title: clamp_value Overloads
hints: Two functions can share the name `clamp_value` as long as their parameter types differ. Write the `int` one, then copy it and change every `int` to `double` (and the defaults to `0.0` and `1.0`).

Defaults go in the parameter list: `int lo = 0, int hi = 100`. They fill from the right, so `clamp_value(7, 1, 5)` overrides both and `clamp_value(150)` uses both. If you ever split declaration from definition, the defaults go on the declaration only.
